name: kinderpowers
description: Rust-native MCP servers for Claude Code: compressed GitHub reads and structured stepwise planning

plugins.name: kp-github
plugins.description: Token-compressed GitHub MCP server — a full superset of the official GitHub plugin returning ~11x fewer tokens, with a CI-enforced compression floor, the branch_status primitive, and opt-in usage telemetry

plugins.name: kp-stepwise
plugins.description: Structured stepwise planning MCP server — branching, confidence tracking with Dunning-Kruger detection, abstraction layers, per-model profiles, and isolated room/channel state. Hints are signposts, not walls

plugins.name: kinderpowers
plugins.description: Both MCP servers in one plugin (kp-github + kp-stepwise). The original entry, kept so existing installs keep working; the agency-preserving skills layer it used to ship is archived
